1. [Maximum mark: 12]
Let $A = \{1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9\}$, $B = \{1, 5, 6, 7, 9\}$ and $C = \{1, 2, 7, 8, 9\}$.
(a) (i) Find $(A \setminus B) \setminus C$ where $\setminus$ represents set difference.
(ii) Find $A \setminus (B \setminus C)$.
(iii) Hence determine whether set difference is associative. [5]
(b) Find $(A \Delta B) \Delta C$ where $\Delta$ represents symmetric difference. [2]
(c) By considering the sets $A$, $B$ and $C$, determine whether symmetric difference is distributive over intersection. [5]
